name: 08816 · E Brunswick, NJ
findings: ZIP 08816 (E Brunswick) has 197 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08816 (E Brunswick) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
